official.deadline_note: There is no separate scholarship deadline. SUTD states 'Application for the scholarships is made at the same time as application for admission to SUTD', so the effective deadline is the SUTD undergraduate admissions application deadline.
official.application_cycle: Tied to the SUTD undergraduate admissions cycle
official.status_note: SUTD publishes no separate scholarship round or deadline; applicants indicate scholarship interest within the admission application, and SUTD evaluates admission and scholarship together.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Scholarship covers the subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant) for the normal duration (up to four years) of the respective bachelor degree programmes at SUTD. For Scholarships awarded to Singapore Permanent Residents or International Students, tuition fees coverage will be capped at the fees payable by a Singapore Citizen.
benefits: The subsidised tuition fees (after Tuition Grant) for the normal duration (up to four years) of the respective bachelor degree programmes at SUTD
No bond is attached to the Scholarship
eligibility: Open to Singapore Citizens who are applying for admission to SUTD's undergraduate degree programme
Have outstanding Singapore-Cambridge GCE 'A' Level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or Year 12 equivalent qualifications
Have a passion for technology and design
As a special concession, the Scholarship may also be awarded to Singapore Permanent Residents or International Students who have demonstrated exceptional and outstanding achievements
requirements: The recipient must take up the Tuition Grant Scheme (TGS) from the Singapore Government to enjoy subsidised fees
The recipient is required to achieve and maintain good academic standing; academic performance will be reviewed every term
Recipients are required to complete at least 20 hours of service to the University, which may include acting as student ambassador or a similar role
Recipients may not, without the approval of the University, hold concurrently any other scholarships or grants
The scholarship may be withdrawn at any time if, in the opinion of the University, the recipient's academic progress or conduct is deemed unsatisfactory
selection_criteria: Scholarships are awarded on the basis of competition among eligible applicants

SUTD reserves the right to not award any scholarship if there are no candidates of sufficient merit; the decision of the selection committee is final and enquiries or disputes surrounding its decisions will not be entertained
SUTD evaluates the application for admission and scholarship at the same time, and informs the applicant of the specific scholarship awarded along with the admission offer
coverage: Subsidised tuition fees after the Tuition Grant, for the normal duration of the programme up to four years
Capped at the fees payable by a Singapore Citizen for awards made to Singapore Permanent Residents or International Students
application_method: Indicate interest to apply for the SUTD scholarships in the SUTD admission application
Shortlisted applicants will be notified in due course
Applicants may also apply for donor scholarships at the same time to improve their chances
official.application_route: No separate application: indicate scholarship interest in the SUTD admission application; admission and scholarship are assessed together.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to Singapore Citizens; as a special concession may also be awarded to Singapore Permanent Residents or International Students with exceptional and outstanding achievements.
official.international_eligibility: Only by special concession for Singapore Permanent Residents or International Students who have demonstrated exceptional and outstanding achievements, with tuition coverage capped at Singapore Citizen fee levels.
official.duration: The normal duration of the respective SUTD bachelor degree programme, up to four years
official.description: SUTD describes the SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship as recognising outstanding students who demonstrate academic excellence and have a penchant for creating radical technology and innovative designs, with the recipient described as a brilliant and well-rounded individual constantly pursuing technological breakthroughs for the betterment of mankind.
official.program_type: Merit-based tuition scholarship for new undergraduate admission applicants

not_confirmed: a scholarship application deadline or cycle dates
verification.notes: Read the SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship page and the SUTD-administered scholarships overview on sutd.edu.sg. The page publishes no monetary value and no separate scholarship deadline; the document list is not published because the application is made within the admission application. The catalogue row's 'English requirement' text was page furniture, not a requirement.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no scholarship form to fill in: you indicate your interest in the admission application and SUTD assesses admission and scholarship together, telling you which award you received alongside the offer. That also means you cannot negotiate which SUTD scholarship you get, and the selection committee's decision is final with no disputes entertained. What you get here is the subsidised tuition fee after the Tuition Grant for up to four years, with no living stipend, so treat it as a fee waiver rather than full funding.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with outstanding GCE A-Level, local polytechnic, NUS High School, IB or Year 12 results and a design-and-technology bent applying to SUTD.
application_readiness_checklist: Indicate scholarship interest inside the admission application itself; there is no separate scholarship submission to make.
Take up the Tuition Grant Scheme when you matriculate, because subsidised fees only exist with it.
Also flag donor scholarships in the same application, since SUTD says you may apply for both to improve your chances.
Plan for the 20 hours of service to the University each year, which can mean publicity talks and receiving guests.
Track your GPA against the every-term academic standing review rather than only first-year results.
common_rejection_risks: Waiting for a separate scholarship window that does not exist, and missing the admissions deadline instead.
Expecting a specific SUTD scholarship rather than accepting whichever the committee assigns.
Declining the Tuition Grant Scheme, which removes the subsidised fee the waiver is based on.
Letting academic progress or conduct slip after the award, since withdrawal is at the University's opinion.
Holding another scholarship or grant concurrently without University approval.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Only subsidised tuition after the Tuition Grant is covered; accommodation, living costs, miscellaneous fees, and equipment or project costs are the student's own.
document_audit: No scholarship-specific document list is published; the evidence sits inside the admission application.
For PR or international concession awards, the fee cap is the Singapore Citizen fee level, so confirm what that means for your own fee band before relying on the waiver.
Donor scholarship applications are made as part of the financial aid application, which is a different submission from the admission application.
As SUTD scholarships are made possible with donor support, recipients may be asked to write appreciation notes and attend university or donor events.
alerts: SUTD reserves the right not to award any scholarship if there are no candidates of sufficient merit, and the selection committee's decision is final.
The 20-hour service requirement and possible donor obligations continue for the duration of the award.
If you terminate the scholarship prematurely, SUTD reserves the right to impose a repayment on a case-by-case basis.
Academic performance is reviewed every term, so renewal is not automatic at the year level.
Many other SUTD-administered and donor scholarships on the same page carry richer packages, so check whether another one on the list fits better.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One admission application carrying the scholarship interest flag; admission and scholarship assessed together; the specific award named with the admission offer.
